name: Python for Everybody & Data Analysis
description: Master Python basics, data structures, networked application program interfaces, and databases using Python. Build projects to clean, analyze, and visualize real-world datasets.

name: Full Stack Web Development with React & Node
description: Build modern responsive websites and web applications from front to back. Learn modern JavaScript (ES6+), React, Node.js, Express, REST APIs, and MongoDB database architecture.

name: Machine Learning & Deep Learning Specialization
description: Learn the foundational concepts of Machine Learning and understand how to build practical AI applications. Covers linear regression, neural networks, decision trees, and PyTorch.

name: Data Structures & Algorithms Masterclass
description: Deep dive into essential data structures: arrays, linked lists, hash tables, trees, and graphs. Master algorithmic problem solving, time/space complexity analysis (Big-O), and sorting algorithms.

name: Database Management Systems & SQL Mastery
description: Learn relational database design, ER modeling, SQL querying from basic SELECT statements to complex multi-table JOINs, indexing, normalization, transactions, and NoSQL databases.

name: Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate
description: Gain in-demand skills for cybersecurity analyst roles. Learn network security, threat mitigation, SIEM tools, Python scripting for security, and incident response strategies.

name: Cloud Architecture & DevOps with AWS
description: Master AWS core infrastructure: EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, Lambda, and IAM. Learn how to architect highly available, scalable, fault-tolerant cloud solutions and deploy Docker containers.

name: Java Programming & Software Engineering
description: Designed for students with zero to intermediate experience. Learn object-oriented programming concepts, design patterns, file processing, and build interactive Java desktop and console applications.

name: Modern UI/UX Design & Design Systems in Figma
description: Master user-centric product design principles, wireframing, high-fidelity interactive prototyping in Figma, typography, color harmony, accessibility (WCAG), and responsive design systems.

name: Cross-Platform Mobile Development with Flutter
description: Build high-performance, native iOS and Android apps using Google Flutter framework and Dart. Learn state management (Provider/Bloc), REST API integrations, and Firebase backend synchronization.

name: Data Science & Big Data Analytics with Python
description: Gain hands-on skills in data wrangling with Pandas and NumPy, data visualization with Matplotlib and Seaborn, statistical hypothesis testing, and predictive modeling.

name: Computer Networks & Network Protocols
description: Understand the fundamentals of modern networking: OSI and TCP/IP stack models, routing protocols, packet switching, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS encryption, and firewall architectures.

name: Generative AI & LLM Application Engineering
description: Learn generative AI lifecycle, prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures, vector databases (Pinecone/Chroma), LangChain, and fine-tuning open source models.

name: DevOps Engineering: CI/CD, Docker & Kubernetes
description: Learn practical DevOps tools and continuous integration/continuous delivery pipelines with GitHub Actions, container orchestration with Kubernetes clusters, Helm charts, and Terraform IAC.

name: C++ Systems Programming & Memory Management
description: Master modern C++ (C++17/20), pointers and references, manual memory management, RAII, STL containers and algorithms, multithreading, and low-level systems programming concepts.

name: Blockchain Foundations & Smart Contract Development
description: Explore cryptographic hash functions, consensus algorithms (PoW, PoS), Ethereum architecture, and write decentralized applications (DApps) and Solidity smart contracts.
